description.narrative: The project is expected to enable the Company in expanding its fiber optic backbone and metro network, which is expected to directly contribute to increasing the capacity of broadband networks in the country. This could then also indirectly facilitate improved access to quality digital connectivity for individuals and businesses in Mexico. Beyond the project, the project is expected to increase the competitiveness of Mexicos wholesale and retail fixed broadband markets by strengthening the competitive dynamics in broadband markets in the country. The expansion of a wholesale market challengers' network is expected to not only encourage competition in the wholesale segment, but also lower costs for retail operators and reinforcing competition in the downstream retail market serving customers.

The proposed investment entails a local currency-denominated (Mexican Pesos) senior loan of up to US$30 million equivalent in MXN to IENTC S. de R.L. de C.V. (IENTC or the Company) to finance the expansion of its fiber-optic backbone and metro network, enhancing capacity, connectivity and redundancy across Mexico (the Project).
